title: Shannon: sender, channel, receiver
summary: Communication is a three-body system, not a pipe: noise is a property of the channel, so sender and receiver must encode and decode around it. Structured redundancy (error-correcting codes shaped to the channel) is the coordination architecture that lets communication survive noise, up to the channel's capacity.
source: Ch02 — 'The Bit as Coordination Quantum' (replaces the Game of Life figure)
